# ZON's part is hand-written: the library's transduce-tree steps over json's spec for the containers and the keys, and its own scalar, which yields the reader's big integer, the object {"$big": "<digits>"} a token carries, as that object, and every other token's value as the scalar it is, a number's lexeme kept where JSON spells it so (2.50) and its value written otherwise (0x10); a character literal and an enum literal as the value the reader resolved, a multiline string as its text, the empty struct as the empty array, a quoted name as it is spelled.

def zon-transduce-spec
  record
    entry :map (record (entry :container :object))
    entry :list (record (entry :container :array))
    entry :pair (record (entry :key 0))
    entry :val (record (entry :scalar 0))

def zon-transduce-value [value]
  match (kind value)
    case :record
      match (keys value)
        case [name] [object-start (key name) (scalar (get name value)) object-end]
        case _ (fail :unrepresentable "a token's value is a record the stream has no form for")
    case _ [(scalar value)]

def zon-transduce-step [state pass]
  match pass
    case (open rule)
      match (get (get :name rule) zon-transduce-spec)
        case missing (transition state [])
        case entry
          match (get :scalar entry)
            case missing (transduce-open zon-transduce-spec state rule)
            case _
              match (get-path (path 0) (get :tokens rule))
                case missing (transition state [])
                case token (transition state (zon-transduce-value (get :val token)))
    case (close rule) (transduce-close zon-transduce-spec state rule)

  as-events (scan-emit [[] false] zon-transduce-step transduce-finish (parser-events input))

# CSV's part is hand-written: the csv rule's passes open and close the array, a record's its object after the header, a val's close yields the cell under the header's name at its position, or field~ and the position past the header, an elem that opens without pushing a val or closes giving its token back on the comma group is an empty cell, and a record's close fills the header cells it lacks with the empty string; an empty document, which makes no pass, is the empty array at finish. Every event is the walk of the grammar's value under its default options.

def csv-transduce-cell [value state]
  match state
    case [:header names cells] (transition [:header (push value names) cells] [])
    case [:row names cells]
      let [n (count cells)]
        match (get-path (path n) names)
          case missing (transition [:row names (push true cells)] [[(string-join "" ["field~" (scalar-text (record) n)]) value]])
          case name (transition [:row names (push true cells)] [[name value]])
    case _ (transition state [])

def csv-transduce-fills [names cells]
  map (fn [j] [(get-path (path j) names) ""]) (filter (fn [j] (match (compare j (count cells)) (case :less false) (case _ true))) (indices names))

def csv-transduce-step [state pass]
  match pass
    case (open rule)
      match (get :name rule)
        case "csv" (transition [:header [] []] [:array-start])
        case "record"
          match state
            case [:row names cells] (transition [:row names []] [:object-start])
            case _ (transition state [])
        case "elem"
          match (get :alt rule)
            case missing (transition state [])
            case alt
              match (get :p alt)
                case "" (csv-transduce-cell "" state)
                case _ (transition state [])
        case _ (transition state [])
    case (close rule)
      match (get :name rule)
        case "val"
          match (get :value rule)
            case missing (transition state [])
            case value (csv-transduce-cell value state)
        case "elem"
          match (get :alt rule)
            case missing (transition state [])
            case alt
              match [(get :r alt) (get :g alt)]
                case ["" ["comma"]] (csv-transduce-cell "" state)
                case _ (transition state [])
        case "record"
          match state
            case [:header names cells] (transition [:row names []] [])
            case [:row names cells] (transition [:row names []] (push :object-end (csv-transduce-fills names cells)))
            case _ (transition state [])
        case "csv" (transition [:done [] []] [:array-end])
        case _ (transition state [])

def csv-transduce-finish [state]
  match state
    case [:before names cells] [:array-start :array-end]
    case [:done names cells] []
    case _ (fail :protocol-order "the rule passes ended inside the document, which a csv parse's never do")

def csv-transduce-expand [state item]
  match item
    case :array-start (transition state [array-start])
    case :array-end (transition state [array-end])
    case :object-start (transition state [object-start])
    case :object-end (transition state [object-end])
    case [name value] (transition state [(key name) (scalar value)])

def csv-transduce [input]
  as-events (scan-emit [] csv-transduce-expand (fn [state] []) (scan-emit [:before [] []] csv-transduce-step csv-transduce-finish (parser-events input)))
